about.subtitle: Independent web developer · Curitiba
about.text:
Hi, I'm Thomas. I'm an independent web developer based in Curitiba. My curiosity about technology started early: I spent my childhood taking computers apart, built my first PC before I was 10 and, not long after, started building for the web. I never stopped.
I have worked across hardware, infrastructure and software, and as a project manager and systems analyst on projects in Santa Catarina, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and abroad, for brands such as Sephora, Reserva and Hero99. Software is where I feel at home.
I have always been interested in open source. I like learning from other people and helping them solve problems, with objectivity and a bit of fun. I believe in a free web where everyone can experiment, learn and create, and in greener, more sustainable technology. To me, a good site loads fast and solves the problem.
In my free time I play video games, watch movies and series, read and listen to a lot of music. If you want to talk about Vue, Laravel, Linux or anything along those lines, feel free to get in touch.
about.timeline:
2000 | First steps in web development, in the days of plain HTML and CGI
2002 | First version of my personal site
2009–2018 | Projects as a developer, systems analyst and IT project manager, in Santa Catarina, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and for other countries
2019+ | Personal open source projects with Rust, TypeScript, Ansible and GitOps
Today | Independent web developer, in Curitiba
